title: AI Website Builder vs. Professional Website Development
summary: Who an AI website builder suits, where it falls short for a local business that needs leads, what it costs, and how hard it is to move off one later.
keyword: ai website builder vs professional website development
concept: Clean photographic background: a small business owner's desk with a laptop showing a generic, half-finished website layout next to a hand-drawn paper wireframe and a pencil. Right side of frame carries the subject; left side kept calm for the branded navy scrim, logo and headline added by brand-overlay.
